name: wetube-verify
description: WeTube 的本地回归测试依赖。应用本体是 Rust（cargo），这里只给 scripts/verify-*.js 用——其中三条整页注入脚本的测试需要 DOM，靠 jsdom 提供。

scripts.verify: node scripts/verify-download-events.js && node scripts/verify-state-lifecycle.js && node scripts/verify-theater-mode.js && node scripts/verify-captions-mode.js && node scripts/verify-player-quality.js && node scripts/verify-fullscreen.js && node scripts/verify-platform-ui.js && node scripts/verify-shortcuts.js && node scripts/verify-download-panel.js && node scripts/verify-panel-input.js
scripts.verify:no-dom: node scripts/verify-download-events.js && node scripts/verify-state-lifecycle.js && node scripts/verify-theater-mode.js && node scripts/verify-captions-mode.js && node scripts/verify-player-quality.js
